beats.say: Sir Ian McKellen's icon career has now stretched across seven decades.
Born in Burnley on 25 May 1939, he won a Cambridge scholarship in 1958.
After his professional debut in Coventry in 1961, he reached Broadway by 1965.
His breakthrough Tony Award for Amadeus arrived in 1980, before Queen Elizabeth II knighted him in 1991.
In 2026, he joined the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Avengers Doomsday.
What connects seven decades of drama is how early success at university shaped a legendary acting career.
Which McKellen role is your all time favourite?

facts: Sir Ian Murray McKellen was born on 25 May 1939 in Burnley, Lancashire.
In 1958, Sir Ian McKellen won a scholarship to the University of Cambridge at the age of 18.
Sir Ian McKellen made his first professional appearance in 1961 at the Belgrade Theatre in Coventry as Roper in A Man for All Seasons.
Sir Ian McKellen made his Broadway debut in The Promise in 1965.
Sir Ian McKellen won the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play for his role as Antonio Salieri in Amadeus in 1980.
Sir Ian McKellen was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1991.
Sir Ian McKellen starred in the Marvel Cinematic Universe film Avengers Doomsday in 2026.
